About Us

Amitytrans Techno

Instrument transformer manufacturers in India

Amitytrans Techno (I) Pvt. Ltd. (ATIPL) is an instrument transformer manufacturer based in Aurangabad, Maharashtra. Established in 2016, we design, manufacture and supply solutions for the electrical power distribution network.

Our range includes indoor resin cast current transformers (CTs) and potential/voltage transformers (PTs/VTs), outdoor dry type and oil cooled transformers, and CT/PT metering solutions. Our catalogue covers dry type CTs and VTs up to 36 kV HSV and outdoor oil cooled CTs and VTs up to 145 kV HSV.

With a team bringing more than 25 years of experience across design, manufacturing, quality and production, we serve utilities, private customers and switchgear manufacturers. Our focus is consistent quality, customer requirements and continual improvement.
